entities.summary: Belinda Sylvia Taubman Bauer is an Australian-born former actress and psychologist. She gained notice in the 1980s with roles in American films such as Winter Kills (1979) and Timerider: The Adventure of Lyle Swann (1982). Bauer also had a supporting role in the film Flashdance (1983) and a co-starring role as Dr. Juliette Faxx in RoboCop 2 (1990).
